svg.title: Period-3 tangent bifurcation of the logistic map
svg.desc: Third iterate f cubed of the logistic map (mu = 3.835, just past the period-3 window onset 1 + sqrt 8) plotted against the diagonal on the unit square. Squares: the 2 unstable fixed points of f (0 and x*). Filled circles: 3 unstable fixed points of f cubed. Open circles: 3 stable fixed points of f cubed, labeled x1 3*, x2 3*, x3 3*, each next to an unstable one.
